scope: Real filesystem admission rejection before state writes, and two explicit-reference Deep Agents controls on node-local ext4 with actual checkpoint SIGKILL/resume. Audit-only SQLite backup is not worker relocation or neural capability.
timer_note: Fault observation and resumed worker caps are distinct, not a combined600s cap. Whole controller includes all phases.
acceptance_note: Overlapping fixed original/candidate/contracts reused, not new unique tests or neural scores.

backup.source: completed local-checkpoint case with exclusive existing worker lock
backup.method: SQLite backup API to local standalone DELETE-journal database; then private zip
backup.validate: read-only audit JSON identical before/after backup, source DB and WAL frame bytes unchanged

limits: Known filesystem type does not prove disk/firmware durability or defend privileged remounts and hostile path replacement.
Linux ext4 real integration; macOS APFS metadata-only observation and mocked adapter checks, no full macOS worker matrix.
tmpfs admitted but volatile; overlay/FUSE/unknown types rejected rather than presumed local.
No automatic old NFS migration, quota reset, model invocation, host-failure guarantee or cross-host resume.
